approaches.title: Dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Computes the longest increasing subsequence length with a DP value for each ending position, comparing each element with all earlier elements.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial quadratic-time dynamic programming solution that tracks the best increasing subsequence ending at each index.

approaches.title: Greedy with binary search
approaches.summary: Maintains the smallest possible tail value for increasing subsequences of each length and uses binary search to update tails efficiently.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 300: wthelly greedy + binary search approach
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the DP strategy with a greedy tails array and binary search, reducing the time complexity to O(n log n).
